title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19759v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multifingered grasping is a crucial robotic skill, but current deep-learning grasp planners often struggle to generalize to new objects because they are trained on limited, object-specific datasets. We introduce a fundamentally different approach, grounded in the observation that the gripper and the object share identical surface geometry at their mutual contact points. We propose GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation, a novel deep generative model that learns a compact latent representation of a specific gripper's contact surface distribution, enabling the efficient sampling of valid grasp configurations without relying on object-specific training data. We show that by introducing object features only at inference time, our model can effectively retrieve admissible contact areas that are compatible with the gripper's capabilities. translated_title: GOAG：面向灵巧机器人操作的生成式与物体无关抓取规划器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19759v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：多指抓取是一项关键的机器人技能，但当前的深度学习抓取规划器通常难以泛化到新物体，因为它们是在有限、特定于物体的数据集上训练的。我们提出了一种根本不同的方法，基于观察：在相互接触点处，夹爪和物体具有相同的表面几何形状。我们提出了GOAG：面向灵巧机器人操作的生成式与物体无关抓取规划器，这是一种新颖的深度生成模型，它学习特定夹爪接触表面分布的紧凑潜在表示，从而无需依赖特定于物体的训练数据即可高效采样有效的抓取配置。我们展示了通过在推理时仅引入物体特征，我们的模型能够有效检索与夹爪能力兼容的可接受接触区域。我们通过大量实验验证了我们的方法。
tldr: 本论文提出了一种基于夹爪与物体接触表面几何一致性的生成式抓取规划模型，通过学习夹爪接触分布的潜在表示，实现了无需物体特定训练数据即可泛化到新物体的多指抓取规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generative grasp planning model based on the geometric consistency of contact surfaces between gripper and object, learning a latent representation of gripper contact distribution to enable generalizable multifingered grasping on new objects without object-specific training data.
